info.title: Apple News and Music Universal API
info.description: Read Apple Developer news feeds, Apple Newsroom posts, and public Apple media catalog results through Apple’s public RSS surfaces and iTunes Search and Lookup API.

get.description: Retrieves Apple Developer news from the official RSS feed.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

rawXml.description: Raw RSS or Atom XML returned by Apple's public feed.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
